description: Approved new random heroine-background combat traits: amazon/viking 50% berserker, knight 50% paladin, other family 25% veteran; preserve existing traits and omit presets/clones.

edits.new:
if special_stock = 0: gs 'jo9_traits', 'generate'

! JO9 MOD START COMBAT_TRAIT_INNATE_BACKGROUND | 2026-10-19_combat_trait_innate
! Only a newly generated heroine background qualifies. Clone generation replaces this provisional history later.
if special_stock = 0 and creating_clone = 0 and stock['jo9_combat_trait'] = 0 and $stock_occupation = 'heroine':
 jo9_trait_innate_roll = rand(1,100)
 if $stock_family = 'amazon' or $stock_family = 'viking':
  if jo9_trait_innate_roll <= 50: stock['jo9_combat_trait'] = 1
 elseif $stock_family = 'knight':
  if jo9_trait_innate_roll <= 50: stock['jo9_combat_trait'] = 2
 else
  if jo9_trait_innate_roll <= 25: stock['jo9_combat_trait'] = 3
 end
end
killvar 'jo9_trait_innate_roll'
! JO9 MOD END COMBAT_TRAIT_INNATE_BACKGROUND
